fact: Car 27 alleged causing a collision with Car 10 at T1
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 27 was overtaking on the outside and was entitled to the corner however Car 10 made every attempt to give room to Car 27 and did not open his steering. Car 27 still has room on his left at the exit of the turn. Accordingly we determine that no driver was predominantly at fault so no further action is warranted.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 27 Alleged Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber
